claude_transport.scope:
Test the real AgentDocker Claude-channel transport with private daemon state.

The fixture speaks MCP; it is not Claude and does not prove model idle wake.
It verifies idle transport offers, ordered explicit receipts and recovery.
steps: channel waited for initialization, retained its offer, bounded delivery to one unacknowledged head and refused a second owner
eight waiting calls did not block ping or explicit receipt; excess work received visible backpressure
MCP reconnect replayed the same ID; daemon crash retained order and duplicate receipts preserved later messages
a posted human question returns before its answer, which arrives once through the channel with its reply relationship and explicit receipt
an idle transport offered peer input without another request; broken stdout retained the message for reconnect and receipt
an unread full stdout pipe exited within its write bound while stdin stayed open; the oversized-pipe message replayed intact
missing parent-session opt-in refused channel startup instead of racing hook delivery

actual_codex.scope: Actual MCP question late-reply trial: preserve a later peer answer to the completed question without creating another input turn.

actual_claude.scope: Read-only retained evidence audit of the completed actual Claude trial; no new provider run. The original live-controller failure remains unchanged.
actual_claude.failure_cause: Controller treated events_ready as the end of replay. The protocol sends it once subscribed, before replay. See crates/core/src/protocol.rs Events.ready and crates/agentd/src/server.rs stream_events.

provider_binary_reuse: The final 33d52a3 change is UI-only. Its CLI and daemon SHA-256 values exactly match those exercised by actual Codex, actual Claude and the seven channel transport scenarios at 0e20be0. No additional provider run is claimed for 33d52a3.

failures_and_corrections.failure: Initial full gate rejected existing schema 12 after the schema-13 bump (820 passed, one failed).
failures_and_corrections.correction: Extend the migration match through schema 12; final suite covers every supported older schema.

failures_and_corrections.failure: First native review expanded technical Details and failed to display the retained log. Initial inference of restart log loss was wrong.
failures_and_corrections.correction: Use a dedicated compact panel and retain a plain bounded pause reason; diagnose the actual socket error separately.

failures_and_corrections.failure: macOS EINVAL when changing SO_RCVTIMEO after a fast log peer wrote and closed, even with reply bytes still readable.
failures_and_corrections.correction: Set the fixed poll timeout before request transmission; never change socket options after sending. Real-socket regression covers empty and populated fast-close snapshots and a UTF-8 frame split across a timeout. This is not evidence for the older sustained benchmark timeout.

failures_and_corrections.failure: After the socket fix, the first restart driver still expected an empty log and failed while retained logs were present.
failures_and_corrections.correction: Correct the driver to require the persisted log and pause reason; 25 steps passed.

failures_and_corrections.failure: Actual managed Claude fixture aborted before input because process ownership capture could not inspect a short-lived protected process.
failures_and_corrections.correction: Do not weaken identity safeguards. Owned cleanup completed with a forced signal and zero remaining processes; later actual channel trial used an isolated external provider. This failed managed trial is not acceptance.

failures_and_corrections.failure: Actual external Claude acknowledged and replied to the first peer input, then requested user authorization rather than completing all three within the trial deadline.
failures_and_corrections.correction: Preserve this model-behavior failure. A separate bounded trial used one explicit initial typed authorization turn for three fixture messages; it does not establish universal prompt-free authorization.

failures_and_corrections.failure: The authorized Claude trial produced all three ordered receipts/replies, but its controller stopped at events_ready before replay and reported missing receipt events.
failures_and_corrections.correction: Keep the original failed reports unchanged. A read-only SQLite and provider tool-call audit verifies exact receipt-before-ACK ordering, correlated replies, zero queued inputs, one identity and unchanged artifact hashes. No extra provider run or live event replay success is claimed.

limits: Receipt confirms provider input receipt, not task completion or permission to act.
Latest UI receipt covers ordinary Codex input and Claude channel acknowledgements; native/MCP question-result receipts retain their existing ledger paths.
Schema 13 requires a rebuilt daemon; installed launcher and the daemon hosting active user sessions were not replaced.
Guided review is read-only; it does not automatically replay ambiguous input or restart a provider.
Further review types, actual-provider reconnect/crash cuts, sustained/sleep/reboot, signed notification clicks, distribution and platform acceptance remain open.
